ov: Flightless seabirds of the Southern Hemisphere with flippers for swimming. They spend about half their lives on land and half at sea; only the Galápagos penguin lives at the equator.
rg: Almost entirely the Southern Hemisphere, from Antarctica to the Galápagos Islands at the equator.
df: Krill, fish, squid and other sea life, caught with the bill and swallowed whole while swimming.
fx: Some extinct penguins were as tall or as heavy as an adult human.
